name: Cinematic Illustrated Psychology World v1

character.head: large simple round or slightly oval head
character.face: minimal expressive eyes, optional eyebrows, small mouth
character.limbs: very slim simplified illustrated limbs with slight width
character.hands: simple stylized hands, no realistic finger anatomy

hardFails: bare line stickman or whiteboard doodle
globalPrompt: Create a cinematic 2D illustrated frame for a modern psychology YouTube channel. Keep one consistent visual world: stylized stickman-inspired characters with large simple round heads, minimal expressive faces, compact clothed torsos, very slim simplified limbs, simple hands and shoes; characters are clearly simplified but not bare line stickmen and not normal cartoon humans. Use colorful believable environments, clean slightly organic outlines, soft cel shading, natural depth, purposeful cinematic framing, controlled colors, warm/cool lighting and small meaningful details. When no character is needed, diagrams, text schemas, objects, comparisons and metaphors must use the exact same illustration, line, color, shading and lighting language. No photorealism, no 3D/Pixar, no anime, no corporate vector look, no whiteboard doodle style.
